name: dns-resolver
description: A zero-dependency DNS client and resolver built from scratch in Node.js. Packs binary DNS query structures (Headers, Question flags, label-length domain encoding) and decodes DNS response packets (decoding headers, question echoes, records A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, and domain name compression pointers) using UDP sockets.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need to perform DNS queries directly via UDP socket buffers to nameservers (like 8.8.8.8) in restricted runtimes without relying on Node's native dns module.
